title: SEC1: asymmetric DKIM failure semantics need a comment explaining why
description: NNTP queue signing failure = defer/retry; SMTP relay signing failure = permanent dead-letter. This is intentionally asymmetric (NNTP is a retry queue by design; SMTP relay is one-shot). But a reader encountering both paths cold will be confused by the difference. A one-line comment at each site explaining WHY the semantics differ (e.g. '// NNTP queue retries on next cycle; signing failure is transient' and '// SMTP relay is one-shot: signing failure = permanent dead-letter, never retry') would prevent a solo maintainer from accidentally aligning them incorrectly in a future edit.
